name: Alder Ferry Pier
blurb: Splintered cedar pilings jutting into the gray current where flat-bottomed barges once crossed.
discovered_line: Snapped tow-ropes dangle into the eddies beside an overturned toll-chest.

name: Collapsed Brier Watchtower
blurb: A listing timber signal-post choked by thorny vines above the eastern wagon track.
discovered_line: Fletched border arrows still bristle from the charred roof beams.

name: Garrick's Mill-Sluice
blurb: A moss-slick stone weir holding back a stagnant millpond clogged with dead reeds.
discovered_line: The iron sluice-wheel is chained shut, backing foul water over the road.

name: Cairn of Three Spears
blurb: A wind-scoured mound of river cobbles marking an ancient truce between border clans.
discovered_line: Three rusted spearheads jut from the cairn's crown like crooked teeth.

name: Saint Oswin's Wayshrine
blurb: A leaning sandstone niche housing a faceless statue draped in wet woolen ribbons.
discovered_line: Half-burned tallow stubs float in the rainwater pooling at the saint's feet.

name: Old Tanner's Hollow
blurb: Sunken lime-pits and collapsed drying racks hidden inside a damp willow copse.
discovered_line: The sour reek of curing hides lingers beneath freshly turned earth.

name: Shattered Axle Crossing
blurb: A shallow gravel bar littered with splintered oak spokes and waterlogged grain sacks.
discovered_line: Deep bootprints lead straight from the wrecked supply wagon into the brush.

name: The Crooked Willow
blurb: A gnarled riverside tree whose lowest bough bears frayed hemp nooses over the mud.
discovered_line: Crows scatter from the branches, leaving behind brass buttons in the silt.

name: Redbank Flint Pit
blurb: Stepped chalk excavations where border knappers once mined spark-stone for garrison tinderboxes.
discovered_line: Abandoned iron picks lie rusting beside piles of sharp, freshly split chert.

name: Flooded Tithe-Granary
blurb: A squat brick storehouse tilted half into the riverbank after last autumn's surge.
discovered_line: Sprouting barley spills through a cracked cellar grate into the black mud.

name: Smoldering Peat Kilns
blurb: Domed brick ovens sunken into the bog, venting thin tendrils of acrid yellow smoke.
discovered_line: Charred wheelbarrows sit abandoned beside stacks of black turf bricks.

name: The Drowned Belfry
blurb: Only the stone steeple of an old parish chapel rises above the stagnant red water.
discovered_line: A cracked bronze bell sways slightly whenever marsh gas bubbles up below.

name: Stilt-Hut of Bog-Mire
blurb: A leaning reed shack perched on rotting cypress poles above a scum-covered pool.
discovered_line: Glass jars filled with dark, writhing shapes hang from the eaves.

name: The Rib-Bone Causeway
blurb: A narrow footpath paved with bleached animal ribs and split logs across bottomless mire.
discovered_line: Every step sinks an inch, squelching black water over the ancient bones.

name: Sunken Siege-Battery
blurb: Rotted timber platforms holding two half-submerged trebuchets from a forgotten rebellion.
discovered_line: Sling-ropes hang like dead vines above crates of moss-covered stone shot.

name: Weeping Alder Thicket
blurb: Twisted bog-trees dripping amber sap into dark pools choked with crimson duckweed.
discovered_line: Tattered scraps of pilgrim cloth flutter from the lowest thorns.

name: The Quicklime Trench
blurb: A long, sunken ditch crusted with white lime along the edge of the eastern dike.
discovered_line: Broken wooden shovels jut from the crust like crooked grave markers.

name: False-Light Beacon
blurb: An iron cage mounted on a crooked pole where pale marsh-lights gather after dusk.
discovered_line: Skeletal hands still clutch the base of the post beneath a foot of peat.

name: Mire-Cult Stone
blurb: A flat slab of black basalt carved with spiral channels stained dark with dried blood.
discovered_line: Woven reed idols sit in a ring around a bowl of foul bog-water.

name: The Beached Fen-Barge
blurb: The mossy hull of a flat-bottomed troop transport wedged firmly into a peat hummock.
discovered_line: Rusted shields still hang along the gunwales above a flooded cargo hold.

name: Cracked Brine Pans
blurb: Terraced stone basins along the tidal flats crusted with dirty gray sea-salt.
discovered_line: Wooden rakes lie snapped beside mounds of uncollected salt crystals.

name: Leviathan Jaw-Gate
blurb: Two colossal sun-bleached rib bones lashed together over a narrow cliffside smugglers' path.
discovered_line: Salt wind whistles through carved sailor-marks etched into the bone.

name: Blind-Beacon Tower
blurb: A salt-eaten stone lighthouse whose bronze mirror was smashed out during a corsair raid.
discovered_line: Cold ash fills the fire-pan while gull nests choke the spiral stairs.

name: The Splintered Cove
blurb: A jagged reef impaling the broken hulls of three royal patrol galleys.
discovered_line: Barnacle-covered oars wash back and forth in the red-stained surf.

name: Harbor Chain-Winch
blurb: A squat capstan house holding one end of a rusted harbor-blocking iron chain.
discovered_line: Thick links trail straight down into the crashing waves like a sea-serpent.

name: Tide-Hollow Grotto
blurb: A basalt cavern accessible only at low water, stacked with tarred brandy casks.
discovered_line: Wet bootprints lead deeper into the dark behind a false wall of driftwood.

name: Mariner's Cliff-Niche
blurb: Shallow caves cut into the sea-cliff where drowned sailors' skulls rest behind iron grilles.
discovered_line: Salt-crusted copper coins glint inside empty eye sockets.

name: Sea-Cliff Anchor Smithy
blurb: An open-air stone hearth battered by spray, flanked by half-forged iron flukes.
discovered_line: A massive cracked anvil sits tilted in the wet shingle.

name: The Abyssal Tide-Pool
blurb: A deep circular sinkhole in the coastal rock that churns violently even in calm weather.
discovered_line: Carved stone steps descend straight into the black, foaming water.

name: False-Harbor Gallows
blurb: A tall timber crane perched on a jagged headland to lure merchant ships onto the rocks.
discovered_line: Shattered cargo crates and bleached ribs litter the coves directly below.

name: The Ash-Choked Viaduct
blurb: A towering stone aqueduct whose dry channel is packed three feet deep with gray soot.
discovered_line: Scorched royal banners hang limp from the arches over the barren plain.

name: The Blackened Groves
blurb: Rows of petrified apple trees turned to charcoal by rolling ember-winds from the capital.
discovered_line: Brittle branches snap like dry bones underfoot in the dead silence.

name: Royal Gunpowder Foundry
blurb: A blackened stone manufactory ringed by slag heaps and shattered bronze cannon molds.
discovered_line: Sulfur dust coats the floor beside half-filled barrels of coarse black powder.

name: The Iron-Cage Crossroads
blurb: Tall iron gibbets creaking in the hot wind along the main highway to the inner walls.
discovered_line: Charred parchment decrees remain nailed to the stone base of each post.

name: Square of the Molten Bell
blurb: A cracked marble plaza dominated by a massive cathedral bell fused into a lump of bronze.
discovered_line: Vitrified cobbles mark where crown-fire rained down during the purge.

name: The Soot-Sealed Cistern
blurb: A domed brick reservoir whose iron hatch was welded shut to keep ash from fouling the water.
discovered_line: Scratch marks cover the bronze door where desperate hands tried to pry it open.

name: Scorched Watch-Bastion
blurb: A soot-stained fortress gatehouse flanked by cold iron braziers ten feet wide.
discovered_line: Rows of blackened halberds stand neatly racked beside piles of fused armor.

name: The Cindered Chancellery
blurb: Gutted marble halls where thousands of tax rolls and noble pedigrees burned to black flakes.
discovered_line: A single iron strongbox sits untouched amid knee-deep drifts of paper ash.

name: Ember-Glass Quarry
blurb: Jagged pits of black volcanic glass mined to tip the spears of the royal vanguard.
discovered_line: Razor-sharp splinters glint across the churned earth like fallen stars.

name: The Cinder Causeway
blurb: A wide basalt road lined with headless statues leading directly toward the smoking citadel.
discovered_line: Hot cinders drift across the paving stones like dying fireflies.
